doctrine: PARITY-LEAD (owner, 2026-08-12): adaptive_new supplies verified Go behavior, model-native Python oracles, fixtures, and training breadth; Overgo is the destination. Port capabilities through neutral compiled contracts, then exceed the reference on matched wall and peak memory without quality loss. Multimodality is a recipe-derived contract, not a family checklist: every applicable ordered input/output modality combination (text, image, audio, video, time series, table) must be reachable, evaluated with modality-native evidence, and measured; absent training objectives are explicit refusals, never synthetic substitutes. docs/adaptive_new_parity_report.md is the current assessment; docs/plan.json contains executable open work, never a completion ledger. Every step has a non-vacuous verify; unavailable or skipped evidence fails. PORT-FIRST (owner, 2026-08-09, standing): the point of this campaign is to PORT adaptive_new into overgo, never to reinvent an existing capability. Model-from-scratch training names the capability being ported; it does not waive port-first discipline. Every capability AND performance slice STARTS from adaptive_new's verified implementation: read it end-to-end, port its structure/kernels/math, verify against its goldens. Novel design is admissible ONLY after the port matches the reference, and only as a measured improvement on top of it. A slice that reinvents what adaptive already ships is the named failure mode. The turn is the plan (owner directive 2026-08-09): a session ends only when every item is done or a valid stop reason is recorded (user-stop, irreversible, external-prereq). Deferral to fresh context is NOT a stop reason. cmd/plan owns dispatch bookkeeping; the continuation rule itself lives in skill.md and is followed, not hook-enforced (hook wiring is the owner's environment decision). Owner directive 2026-08-09: (a) per-rung validation is head-to-head -- run the adaptive_new and overgo implementations on the same artifact and inputs, adopt whichever component structures measure better, overgo ends at-or-below on wall+memory; (b) multimodal capabilities are tested when applicable -- image, video, and audio rungs exercise real modality inputs drawn from the repodb dataset catalog (adaptive_new docs/repodb datasets.log; resolved via the dataroot contract), never synthetic-only. Owner directive 2026-08-09 (media models): for every image/video generation rung, verification is vs the PYTHON golden methods (the model repo's native implementation) and the performance bar is BEAT PYTHON on time AND memory WITHOUT degrading generation (quality assertions must pass at exact quality; approximations that fail artifact assertions do not count). Reference evidence + techniques: adaptive_new/image_gen_report.md. Safe levers: exact masked-softmax traffic reduction, rounded-consumer projections, bounded-BF16, pre-decode resource lifetime release, measured residency; quality-fast approximations that fail artifact assertions do not count. Route media denoise through Overgo tensor machinery (retained CUDA-graph replay, BF16-native decode catalog, fusion rewrites, calibrated dispatch), not a second adaptive runtime.
